name: Lu Sung
bio: Lu Sung (陸淞; Lu Song; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 瑞鹤仙 (Rui he xian)
poems.author: Lu Sung
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
脸霞红印枕。
睡觉来、冠儿还是不整。
屏间麝煤冷。
但眉峰压翠，泪珠弹粉。
堂深昼永。
燕交飞、风帘露井。
恨无人，与说相思，近日带围宽尽。
重省。
残灯朱幌，淡月纱窗，那时风景。
阳台路迥。
云雨梦，便无准。
待归来，先指花梢教看，却把心期细问。
问因循、过了青春，怎生意稳。
